# QuantyCoin (QTY) — High-Performance Quantum & AI Era Layer-1 Blockchain
> Decentralized, Quantum-Resilient & High-Throughput Layer-1 Proof-of-Work Ecosystem with Native Qt6 Desktop GUI Suites and Zero-Mock Cryptography.

## Core Technical Summary
- **Protocol Version:** 70015 (v7.0.0 Mainnet)
- **Consensus:** Pure Proof-of-Work (PoW) with LWMA-1 difficulty adjustment computed per block
- **Max Supply:** 21,000,000 QTY (2.1 x 10^15 Satoshis)
- **Target Block Time:** 60 seconds
- **Block Reward:** 50 QTY initial, halving every 2,100,000 blocks (~4 years)
- **Max Block Size:** 32 MB (33,554,432 bytes)
- **Network Ports:** P2P: 19888, RPC: 19889, Stratum Pool: 3333
- **Wire Magic:** `0x5155414E` ("QUAN")
- **Address Schemes:** Native SegWit Bech32 (`qty1q...`), Legacy Base58Check (`Q...`)
- **Native Applications:** Sovereign Full Wallet (built-in Node), Lightning Light Wallet (SPV), Standalone Node Daemon GUI, Standalone Multi-Threaded Miner, and Combined Master Suite.
